items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I have them all -- and you just wonder where this heavenly music could have come from, because Beethoven was a monster as a person.

ctx.x: Now, if you want something again analogous to this idea, there is a marvelous book written by two psychiatrists, a man and wife, and I cannot think of their names, but the book was called Beethoven's Nephew. Now, just go and listen to music. Get the nine symphonies and listen to them all -- I have them all -- and you just wonder where this heavenly music could have come from, because Beethoven was a monster as a person.
